description: Non-private item selections for the CosmeticsLab C1 InventorySimulator static baseline. The private inventories.json is generated from this file by Prepare-CosmeticsLab.ps1 (-SteamId64) and stored only under E:\CS2MOD\app-data. No SteamID or personal data may be committed or bundled into a generic release ZIP.

fileSchema.notes: Top-level object keyed by SteamID64 string. ctWeapons/tWeapons keyed by weapon defindex string. knives/gloves keyed by CsTeam byte string (T=2, CT=3). musicKit uses musicId, not def. stattrak -1 means disabled. hash must be stable/unique per item (plugin equality + econ cache key).
